sourceClassification.target: same work-repository paths; disabled Story data uses meta/scriptorium/modules/story/legacy/files/<source>
sourceClassification.preservation: The Story producer uses bounded exact-file operations and does not parse or rewrite YAML/Markdown, preserving source IDs, unknown fields, frontmatter, and formatting. When Story is re-enabled, opaque files are copied back only when the original source file is absent; target conflicts remain reviewable.

sourceClassification.category: authoritative decisions and provisional unresolved workflow rows
target: same-origin migration recovery for unresolved rows
sourceClassification.preservation: Stable row IDs and complete row fields are retained for approved/rejected decisions; other statuses remain provisional for author review. Story does not duplicate the generic SQLite operations.

sourceClassification.target: rebuild from retained canonical manuscript/entity state
sourceClassification.preservation: These projection tables are classified as rebuildable and their row contents are not imported as author decisions.
Series registry and work bindings remain host configuration; Story does not copy them into work metadata.

proofs.scope: Exact-byte canonical YAML/Markdown import, unknown-field and stable-ID preservation, conflict reporting, disabled opaque preservation, and re-enable restoration.
Generic operation composition, idempotent import, author review, and recovery after data-root replacement have not been established by this evidence file.
